<figure class="wp-block-image size-large jt-hero-kite-shift"><img width="2560" height="1706" src="https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-scaled.jpg" alt="Kitesurf excursion conditions on Union Island in the Grenadines" data-no-lazy="1" srcset="https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-scaled.jpg 2560w, https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-300x200.jpg 300w, https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-1024x682.jpg 1024w, https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-768x512.jpg 768w, https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-1536x1024.jpg 1536w, https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-2048x1365.jpg 2048w, https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/hero-l08-subjects-right-7-1080x720.jpg 1080w" class="wp-image-9587 no-lazy nfd-performance-not-lazy skip-lazy" data-skip-lazy="1" loading="eager" fetchpriority="high" sizes="(max-width: 760px) 92vw, (max-width: 1200px) 100vw, 1400px" decoding="async" /></figure>
<div class="wp-block-group wrap hero__c"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow">The Kite &amp; Wing School · Union Island</span></p>
<h1 class="wp-block-heading">The JT Pro Center Kitesurfing &amp; Wing Foil School &amp; Hotel</h1>
<p class="hero__sub wp-block-paragraph">Founded and run by professional kitesurfer Jeremie Tronet, JT Pro Center is one of the world&#8217;s best places to learn kitesurfing and wing foiling, at the heart of the Grenadines, with private coaching, premium gear, boat support and current accommodation options near the spot.</p>
<p class="kg-related-guide-link" data-kg-internal-link="kitesurfing-vs-wing-foiling">Choosing between lesson options? <a href="https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/kitesurfing-vs-wing-foiling/">Compare kitesurfing and wing foiling</a> before you plan your course.</p>
<p class="hero__sub kg-mobile-hero-sub wp-block-paragraph">Founded by pro kitesurfer Jeremie Tronet, JT Pro Center teaches kitesurfing and wing foiling in the Grenadines with private coaching, premium gear, boat support and current accommodation options near the spot.</p>

<div class="wp-block-group section" id="about"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group wrap story__grid"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group story__txt reveal"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue">In the heart of the Grenadines</span></p>
<h2 class="kg-is-jtprocenter-001 wp-block-heading">One of the world&#8217;s best places to learn kitesurfing and wing foiling</h2>
<p class="lead kg-is-jtprocenter-002 wp-block-paragraph">On beautiful Union Island we have the best kitesurfing and wing foiling conditions, with direct, close access to every other spot in the Grenadines, and access to current villa and studio-style stays near the spot, including Mer et Sel.</p>
<p class="kg-is-jtprocenter-003 wp-block-paragraph">We don&#8217;t only teach beginners. We also welcome experienced kitesurfers and wing foilers to improve during their holiday, ride one of the top Caribbean kite and wing spots, and join our kite cruise excursions between the islands of the Grenadines.</p>
<div class="wp-block-group istats"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><b>25+</b></p>
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span>Years of expertise</span></p>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-group"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><b>1:1</b></p>
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span>Private coaching</span></p>
</div></div>
<div class="wp-block-group"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">

<div class="wp-block-group section jt-season-update kg-is-jtprocenter-004"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group wrap"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group note note--amber"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<h4 class="wp-block-heading">Season update</h4>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">JT Pro Center is fully operational for kitesurf lessons, wing foil lessons, kite and wing gear rental, safety support, beach assistance and accommodation bookings. Hurricane Beryl damaged the former beach bar and restaurant area, so the beach bar is not operating this season. We are hoping for the beach bar to return for the upcoming 2026-2027 season. Lessons continue from our beach setup with staff on site, lounge chairs on the beach, dinghy safety support and launch/landing assistance.</p>
</div></div>
</div></div>
</div></div>

<h3 class="wp-block-heading">Hydrofoil lessons</h3>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Foil coaching for experienced riders, with equipment options that make progression easier.</p>
<p class="kg-inline-link wp-block-paragraph"><a class="service-card__link" href="https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/jtprocenter/learn-kitesurf-caribbean/">View coaching <span>→</span></a></p>

<div class="wp-block-group wrap banner__c" id="getting"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow on-dark kg-is-jtprocenter-005">Travelling to JT Pro Center</span></p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Union Island has its own airport</h2>
<p class="wp-block-paragraph">Unspoilt by mass tourism, you won&#8217;t find much routing info on a traditional flight search, even though Union Island has its own airport. We made a guide to help you find your way here.</p>
<div class="wp-block-group kg-is-jtprocenter-006"><div class="wp-block-group__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="kg-inline-button wp-block-paragraph"><a class="btn btn--gold" href="https://www.kitesurfgrenadines.com/kitesurfing-grenadines/getting-here/">Flights &amp; getting here <span class="arr">→</span></a></p>
</div></div>
</div></div>

<p class="kg-inline-span wp-block-paragraph"><span class="eyebrow eyebrow--blue">Accommodation options</span></p>
<h2 class="wp-block-heading">Stay near the spot</h2>
<p class="lead wp-block-paragraph">Choose studio suites or the luxury Kite House Villa, with current availability confirmed by inquiry and easy planning for lessons, wing foiling, rentals and excursions.</p>
